label: Town of Vernon
header:
# Town of Vernon municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Kerry Amidon presided as Moderator; the Warning's Article 1 prints her as the sole candidate

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Sandra Harris (Chair), Brandon Bucossi, Jean Carr, Shelli Harvey, and Jim Pinkerton for Vernon's five-member board

Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Jean Carr and Shelli Harvey won the two selectboard seats on the 2026 ballot (the Warning prints Harvey as 'Shelli Dunklee Harvey')

Town of Vernon, 2025 Annual Report: the 2026 Warning (Article 1 prints the sole ballot candidates) and the Town Officers page: the Town Officers page lists Heidi Johnson-Clement under 'Town Clerk and Treasurer Appointments' and the elected-clerk line reads Vacant; the office was not on the 2026 ballot, the town having converted it to a Selectboard-appointed office

Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Article 9 passed 52-38 on March 2, 2026, authorizing the Selectboard to appoint the Town Treasurer as Finance Director under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f; Katherine Walker holds the office by appointment. The warned ballot's treasurer candidate Joshua Kubecka was therefore not seated and is not recorded
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names 'Katerine Walker, Financial Director' as Vernon's treasurer contact

Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Chad Baldwin won the 2026 lister seat; Jesse Jobin's term runs to 2028. The third seat drew no candidate ('Lister - remaining year - None' on the Warning) and is left without a membership
Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Jesse Jobin won the First Constable seat on the 2026 ballot
Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Chad Baldwin won the Second Constable seat on the 2026 ballot

sources.note: Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Marylynn Scherlin won the 2026 election; Article 27, to make the office appointed under 17 V.S.A. section 2651d, was defeated 36-51
Town of Vernon, Vernon Free Library page (vernonvt.org): lists five elected trustees -- Cassie Sailsman (Chair), Julie Nevins, Nicole Deyo, Kristin Bratton, and Erin Harris

Town of Vernon, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 2-3, 2026 (signed; town website): Erin Harris won the 2026 library trustee seat by floor article (the report's spelling 'Kristen Bratton' yields to the library page's 'Kristin Bratton'; Deyo appears as 'Nikki' on the library page)
